title: Pair 13 retained failure and repair ledger
status: Historical evidence only; this file is not a release acceptance result.

driverCorrections.issue: Spot header locator matched both the Discovery header and game header.
driverCorrections.correction: Scope reads to the header containing the exact Spot the Difference heading.

driverCorrections.issue: Normal navigation changed qa_rewards_20261024_amari_recent_games and it was absent from the lane allowlist.
driverCorrections.correction: Allow only amari_recent_games in the Puzzle and Spot lane diffs; App launchGame updates this key through its recentGames effect.

driverCorrections.issue: Spot final-pair helper and run loop both owned the Next chapter action.
driverCorrections.classification: driver transition defect; corrected by source inspection
driverCorrections.correction: spotPair leaves the fourth held pair in place; runSpot performs the single Next chapter click. No separate pass is attributed to the earlier driver.

driverCorrections.issue: Puzzle and Spot loops could continue indefinitely when a visible action failed to advance progress.
driverCorrections.correction: Both loops now have authored-count bounds and require exactly one visible progress increment within two seconds; Spot failures preserve completed pair rows and fault-plan details.

productCorrections.issue: Phone A/B square images extended three pixels below the 740px viewport (y=407, height=336, bottom=743).
productCorrections.classification: product layout defect; corrected in later candidate
productCorrections.correction: Product reduced the phone content height by tightening the repeated instruction/header layout; the geometry gate remains unchanged.

productCorrections.issue: A completed historical Spot pair could present chapter completion during replay before the current run's final pair.
productCorrections.classification: product progression defect; corrected in later candidate
productCorrections.evidence: Root source/control review; no standalone retained failure report.
productCorrections.correction: Chapter-finish presentation now requires pending.isLastScene and saved.chapterComplete; receipt reconciliation remains independent and legacy completed chapters receive no new receipt.

productCorrections.issue: Desktop Spot images rendered at 580x580 with y=355 and bottom=935, outside the 844px viewport.
productCorrections.classification: product layout defect; corrected in later candidate
productCorrections.correction: Product constrained the desktop comparison grid to a narrower centered width; the viewport geometry gate remains unchanged.

abortedRun.status: Aborted by closing only the named QA browser session and restoring the same retained synthetic profile. The callback returned no structured result, so it is not a pass.
abortedRun.dataHandling: No storage reset, raw seeding, or progress clearing occurred.
abortedRun.followup: Bounded visible-count waits were added to stop stalled loops with a diagnostic error.

priorMechanicCoverage.result: All 12 scenes and 200 placements completed before the Spot header failure. Local progress write and committed-readback faults both fired and retried. The starter chapter parent write/readback faults retried token dino:puzzle:starter:complete for exactly +2 points. Three puzzle receipt claims were present after the full Puzzle lane (+6 total points); this run did not complete Spot.

The native 390x740 matrix passed all 12 Puzzle scenes and 12 Spot pairs. Spot local write/readback faults and naturally eligible challenge-receipt parent write/readback faults fired and retried token dino:spot:challenge:complete for exactly +2 points. Puzzle local write/readback fault passed; no Puzzle parent receipt was naturally eligible in this run.

eligibilityCaveat: The same retained profile now contains prior progress and receipts. Later CSS-only source changes do not recreate fresh receipt eligibility. Report a parent fault as unavailable when all natural eligible receipts have already been claimed; do not reset or seed progress to reproduce it.
